title: whatsapp_inbox._booking_failed
description: The payload of `appointments.booking_request.failed`, verbatim. Same rule as its twin: a listener receives the event payload untouched, system params included, so `additionalProperties` stays TRUE. Only `request_id` is required — a refusal that arrived without a reason still has to reopen the request, because a request stuck on `confirmed` with no appointment is precisely the silent failure this is here to prevent.

request_id.description: The request whose booking was refused. It goes back to `pending_review` so the operator can pick another slot and approve again.

reason_code.description: The stable namespaced code of the refusal (`appointments.overlapping_appointment`). Stored as `failure_code`: a screen or a flow can branch on it, and the module that emitted it can translate it.

reason.description: The sentence, written by whoever refused — the one who knows why. Stored as `failure_reason` and painted as-is in the inbox.
